title: Inflation: Your $10,000 Never Changed. So Where Did It Go?
description:
Inflation can shrink a $10,000 balance without a single withdrawal. Between 2015 and 2025 a $100 basket rose to about $138. Where did the missing value actually go, and why did most of it vanish in three years?

In this video: what is inflation, inflation explained, savings and inflation, inflation and savings, how inflation works, inflation 10 years, inflation effect on savings, purchasing power, cost of living.

We trace the real 2015–2025 story: the calm years, the 2022 price shock, the rate hikes, and why most savers' interest barely moved. Every figure is rounded and sourced below.
